content:
**Chickens** are creatures found in Appalachia and The Trading Post in Shenandoah National Park.

Chickens are docile, fleeing as soon as combat breaks out in their vicinity. A staff member at the Enclave Research Facility remarks that chickens are not as mutated as other creatures in the area and that they are edible. [1] Delbert Winters also mentions that chickens can be used to make soup. [2] 

| Name (Form ID) | Abilities | Items | 
| **Chicken**00111237 EncCritterChicken01Template | | | 

- Approximately five can be found at Foundation, in the chicken pen next to the garden.
- One dead chicken can be found in the outdoor kitchen of Rollins Labor Camp.
- Two chickens will appear inside a chicken coop, if built in a C.A.M.P. or a workshop. They will produce Raw Fertilizer, but cannot otherwise be interacted with.
- One chicken will spawn as part of a random encounter, chasing a terrified wastelander, who will ask for anyone nearby to kill it. Afterward, they will express their gratitude, calling the chicken a "monster."

Chickens can be found at specific locations that have a chance to spawn as a combined critter trio of a beaver, cat, chicken, fox, frog, Opossum, rabbit, Radstag or squirrel, including:

- North of moonshiner's shack, at a campsite.
- The pond west of the Isolated Cabin.
- Southwest of Gauley Mine.
- Northwest of the Overseer's Camp, across the bridge.
- Northeast of Hunter's Ridge.
- South of Poseidon power substation PX-01.
- Northeast of Camp Adams.
- Southeast of Camp Adams Lookout.
- East of Charleston Station.
- Top of the hill southeast of Cow Spots Creamery.
- Between Lakeside Cabins and Summersville, on the dry lakebed.
- Southwest of Burdette Manor.
- South of Hornwright Summer Villa.
- West of Morgantown Station.
- East of Hemlock Holes Maintenance.
- West of Hemlock Holes.
- East of Woods Estate.
- East of abandoned mine shaft 6.
- The road east of Garrahan Mining Headquarters.
- North of Red Rocket Filling Station.
- Southeast of Lake Reynolds, on a construction site.
- Next to a house on the railroad tracks south of Sunnytop Station.
- East of Monongah Power Substation MZ-01.
- The road northeast of Monongah Mine.
- On route 63, east of Pleasant Valley Station.
- East of the Freak Show.
- East of scenic overlook.
- Outside of east entrance of Foundation.
- South of the Monorail Elevator.
- At The Trading Post

Chickens appear in *Fallout 76*.
